name: @projexlight/sdk-vault
summary: Typed KMS facade and 7-tier key hierarchy for ProjexCloud. Wraps AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure Key Vault / HSM behind a single interface, manages envelope encryption with per-tenant + per-app + per-encounter data keys, runs the quarterly rotation scheduler, and supports BYOK/CMEK where the customer holds the wrapping key. Every encrypt/decrypt traverses the audit chain via sdk-audit.

endpoints.description: Liveness probe; confirms KMS connectivity and current rotation status.
Issue a new key in the 7-tier hierarchy under the caller's tenant scope.
Force a manual rotation of a key (otherwise rotation is quarterly via the scheduler).
Cryptographically shred a key — all envelopes wrapped by it become undecryptable.
Encrypt a payload under a named data key; returns a base64 envelope.
Decrypt an envelope; emits an audit entry for every decrypt.

events.name: vault.key.rotated.v1
events.description: Key rotated; carries old + new version refs.

events.name: vault.key.shredded.v1
events.description: Key cryptographically destroyed; all dependent envelopes are now undecryptable.

events.name: vault.cmk.bound.v1
events.description: P8 Variant A: customer-managed key bound as the wrapping key for a tenant.

events.name: vault.cmk.revoked.v1
events.description: P8 Variant A: customer revoked their CMK; tenant data becomes UndecryptableError.

models.description: Master key registry; tier + status + version + KMS-backend reference.
Every encrypt/decrypt/rotate/shred for forensic replay; chained to sdk-audit.
Per-encounter ephemeral keys (L5 in the identity model); auto-shredded at encounter close.
P8 Variant A: which tenants have CMK bindings + which provider (AWS / GCP / Azure).
Per-decrypt log against a CMK; powers the SIEM forwarder for customer audit pipelines.
CMK rotation history with grace-window timestamps.

hooks.name: startRotationScheduler
hooks.description: Background worker that rotates eligible keys on the quarterly cadence; safe to leave running in dev.

hooks.name: setByokEmitter
hooks.description: Wire an event-emitter callback so an external system can react to vault.cmk.* events.

hooks.name: setSiemForwarder
hooks.description: Wire a SIEM HTTP forwarder so customer SOCs see every CMK use in their own pipelines.

scenarios.title: Issue a tenant-tier data key on first tenant boot
scenarios.when_to_use: Called by sdk-tenant after a fresh tenant.created.v1 lands. Required before any tenant-scoped write can be encrypted.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns a KeyRecord with status='active'; emits vault.key.created.v1 to the per-tenant audit chain; the key is immediately usable for encrypt/decrypt.

scenarios.title: Encrypt a PII field with envelope encryption
scenarios.when_to_use: Any time an SDK writes PII (e.g., identity.person email, billing tax-id) and the column expects an envelope-encrypted blob.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns { bytes, dek_id, kms_version }. Adds one row to vault.key_operation. Reversible via decrypt() with the same context object.

scenarios.title: Auto-rotate every quarter via the scheduler
scenarios.when_to_use: Leave the scheduler running in your service binary. Per-key rotation eligibility is determined by tier + last-rotated-at.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Eligible keys flip to a new version; old version remains for a 10-minute grace window so in-flight decrypts succeed. Emits vault.key.rotated.v1 per rotation.

scenarios.title: BYOK / Variant A: customer revoke makes tenant data undecryptable
scenarios.when_to_use: When a customer using P8 Variant A revokes their CMK from their KMS — your decrypt path must surface UndecryptableError, not stall.
scenarios.expected_outcome: decrypt() throws UndecryptableError immediately (no retry storm). Emits vault.cmk.revoked.v1 if first observation. Operator console shows the tenant as 'CMK-locked'.

scenarios.title: Per-encounter ephemeral key auto-shredded at close
scenarios.when_to_use: Whenever an encounter (L5) holds short-lived sensitive data — visit recordings, in-flight chat transcripts. The key dies with the encounter.
scenarios.expected_outcome: On closeEncounter the encounter_key_seal row is deleted, sealed envelopes become undecryptable, and an audit entry is written. Any later decrypt against that key fails with UndecryptableError.

compliance_posture.notes: FIPS-140-2 / 140-3 KMS providers required for FedRAMP. PCI-DSS req 3.5/3.6 satisfied by envelope encryption + quarterly rotation + key_operation audit. HIPAA encryption-at-rest satisfied. P8 Variant A (BYOK) is the path for customers who need CMEK control.
